artifacts.summary: The countermodel half of BimodalLib: the generic entry type, 13 kernel-checked rows across all three grades, both transfer theorems, gates-as-data, lookup up to renaming, the index census, and the near-miss build invariant.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the countermodel half of BimodalLib: a PointTruth-generic CountermodelEntry whose refutation field the kernel checks and whose profile_eq makes filing computed; 13 rows covering SEMANTIC (11), CERTIFICATE (1) and GATED TABLEAU (1); both TRANSFER theorems; the eight branch gates bundled with their bridge theorem; lookup of an inference up to renaming of atoms; a generated index section with a per-grade census; assert_near_miss_targets_resolve as a build invariant; tests in both directions; and docs/reference/bimodal-lib.md documenting the grades. BimodalLib carries no sorry, no new axiom and no native_decide.

sapience_notes.subject: Lean 4 open-in prefix and docstring order
sapience_notes.value: An `open X in` prefix must come BEFORE a declaration's docstring, not after it: the docstring is part of the declaration syntax the prefix wraps, so `/-- doc -/ open X in def f` fails with "unexpected token 'open'; expected 'lemma'". Measured on Lean v4.33.0-rc1.

sapience_notes.subject: Lean 4 multi-line structure instance indentation
sapience_notes.value: A multi-line structure instance written `return { a := x, b := y,` with continuation lines indented less than the first field's column fails with "unexpected identifier; expected '}'", and the reported column points at the END of the last accepted line rather than at the offending token -- which sends you hunting for a reserved-token clash. Put the brace alone at the end of its line and indent all fields uniformly.

sapience_notes.subject: A Name set with double-backtick syntax reads back as Name.str, not Name.mkStr
sapience_notes.value: In Lean 4.33 metaprogramming, a `Name` field populated with ``Foo reduces to an Expr headed by the CONSTRUCTOR `Name.str`, so a reader matching `Name.mkStr`/`Name.mkNum` (the ToExpr alias shape) returns none on it. A robust reader must handle Name.anonymous/Name.str/Name.num as well as the mkStr aliases.

sapience_notes.subject: linter.style.longLine scope in a Lean package
sapience_notes.value: Measured in BimodalLogic: `linter.style.longLine` fires on CODE lines but not on docstring lines. A 135-character `#guard_msgs` expected-output docstring drew no warning while 107- and 111-character code lines each failed a `--wfail` build. So a verbatim expected-output block needs no exemption, but a long `#print axioms` line does.

sapience_notes.subject: A new module's basename can silently break an unrelated citation lint
sapience_notes.value: Adding BimodalLib/Countermodel/Transfer.lean collided by basename with FormalSystem/Metalogic/WeakCanonical/Transfer.lean and flipped three bare `Transfer.lean:NNN` citations in two unrelated files from resolvable to ambiguous, breaking a pinned residual ceiling. Third recorded occurrence of the mechanism in this repo. Nothing warns at the point the new file is added; check new module basenames against the existing tree before landing them.

sapience_notes.subject: A research probe's maxRecDepth should be re-measured, not inherited
sapience_notes.value: A research probe discharged eight decidable branch gates under `set_option maxRecDepth 10000`; re-measured at implementation time, `decide` closed the same goal at the DEFAULT depth of 512 with no set_option at all. Carrying the probe's bump forward would have hidden a later regression in exactly the quantity it was raised to protect.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh derives paths from the whole working tree
sapience_notes.value: Under a concurrent sibling dispatch, verify-touched.sh's own touched-path derivation picks up the sibling's untracked files and selects a large battery of suites unrelated to the current task -- 87 agent-system shell suites, selected over another dispatch's .githooks/* files. A per-gate scoped invocation (verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N --skip-unchanged) is the reliable scoped discharge when siblings are active.

sapience_notes.subject: A plan premise about a measured fact must be re-checked before it is written into an artifact
sapience_notes.value: A plan instructed recording in a Lean definition's note field that its premise list was non-empty and uniquely so. Measured false: the witness family it was built from is declared over the empty context, so the list is empty. The research report had only claimed the underlying theorem takes a premise list natively -- a claim about a signature, which the plan over-read into a claim about the instance. Writing the instruction verbatim would have put a false statement into the source.
